description: This file contains implementation details for quantized linear prepacking operations optimized for CPU, including support for FBGEMM and QNNPACK backends. It defines functions for preparing weight tensors for efficient quantized linear algebra computations, including calculation of column offsets and prepacking weight matrices with optional bias handling.
